# Shortform

> Shortform provides world-class book summaries and expert-curated reading lists across business, personal development, finance, and wellness categories.

Shortform is a learning platform offering comprehensive book summaries with detailed analysis, curated best-books lists by genre, and subscription access to thousands of titles. The platform features summaries of bestselling works by authors like Stephen Covey, Robert Kiyosaki, and Tim Ferriss, alongside expert recommendations and rankings.

## Core Platform

- [Shortform - The World's Best Book Summaries](https://www.shortform.com): Shortform homepage showcasing world-class book summaries for learning.
- [Our Summaries | Shortform - The World's Best Book Summaries](https://www.shortform.com/summaries): Explains Shortform's summary methodology and competitive advantages.
- [Pricing | Shortform - The World's Best Book Summaries](https://www.shortform.com/pricing): Subscription plans and pricing for Shortform membership access.
- [About | Shortform - The World's Best Book Summaries](https://www.shortform.com/about): Company background, mission, and founder Allen Cheng information.

## Popular Book Summaries

- [The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People Book Summary by Stephen R. Covey](https://www.shortform.com/summary/the-7-habits-of-highly-effective-people-summary-stephen-covey): Detailed summary of Covey's 7 Habits for personal effectiveness.
- [Rich Dad Poor Dad Book Summary by Robert T. Kiyosaki](https://www.shortform.com/summary/rich-dad-poor-dad-summary-robert-kiyosaki): Comprehensive summary of Kiyosaki's wealth-building financial guide.
- [The 4-Hour Workweek Book Summary by Tim Ferriss](https://www.shortform.com/summary/the-4-hour-workweek-summary-tim-ferriss): Detailed summary of Ferriss's lifestyle design and automation guide.
- [The Power of Habit Book Summary by Charles Duhigg](https://www.shortform.com/summary/the-power-of-habit-summary-charles-duhigg): In-depth summary of Duhigg's habit formation and behavior change.
